name: Empo
subtitle: Run RPG Maker and PSDK games on iPhone and iPad.
description: Empo is a native SwiftUI game library with customizable touch controls. It runs RPG Maker XP, VX, and VX Ace games, modern Pokemon Essentials forks, and PSDK games on the device, with no desktop emulator.

apps.name: Empo
apps.subtitle: Run RPG Maker and PSDK games on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription:
Empo is a native SwiftUI game library with customizable touch controls. It runs RPG Maker XP, VX, and VX Ace games, modern Pokemon Essentials forks, and PSDK games on the device, with no desktop emulator.

Features:
- Plays games made for RGSS1 (XP), RGSS2 (VX), RGSS3 (VX Ace), modern mkxp-z forks, and PSDK
- Picks the right engine and Ruby version (1.8, 1.9, 3.0, 3.1) for each game
- Imports games from folders, .zip, .7z, .rar, and JoiPlay's .jgp format
- Customizable on-screen D-pad and action buttons, with per-game layouts
- Pause and resume from the library with a hero zoom transition
- Library with sort, search, grid/list views, and bulk delete
